title: Highlights Of Sri Lanka
highlights: Witness the majestic elephants in their natural habitat, offering a heartwarming experience of rehabilitation and care at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
Immerse yourself in the vibrant rhythms and traditional dances of Kandy, showcasing the island's rich cultural heritage
Encounter spiritual serenity at the Temple of Tooth Relic, housing the revered Buddha Tooth Relic amidst intricate architecture and religious rituals
Embark on an exhilarating adventure with a Jungle Safari in Yala National Park & encounter the untamed beauty of nature, catching glimpses of majestic wildlife
Discover divine serenity at the Hanuman Temple in Nuwara Eliya, which is believed to be Lord Hanuman's resting spot while on a mission to rescue Goddess Sita
overview:
About the tour:
Embark on an unforgettable journey with this Sri Lanka Tour Package, exploring the island's cultural and natural wonders. Begin in Kandy, where the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and the sacred Buddha Tooth Relic Temple await. Stroll by the picturesque Kandy Lake and witness the mesmerizing Kandyan Dance. Journey to Nuwara Eliya, relishing the tranquillity of Gregory Lake, the Hanuman Temple, and the mystical Seetha Amman Temple amidst lush landscapes and the enchanting Ramboda Falls. Yala beckons with a thrilling Jungle Safari in Yala National Park. In Bentota, marvel at Turtle Hatchery and unwind with a leisurely evening at Madhu River. Conclude your adventure in Colombo, by exploring its vibrant cityscape. Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Sri Lanka's beauty and culture on this breathtaking journey.

1 night stay in Yala with breakfast

1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: The above mentioned rates for the package are valid for the Indian Nationals only.
All entry tickets for attractions, state and entry fees, boat rides, camera charges,etc. are not a part of the package.
Early check in & late checkout prices are not a part of the package.

All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package. (Please visit www.eta.gov.lk for more details / submit your individual visa application)
The above rates would vary and won't be the same on special days such as Diwali, Dussehra, Christmas and New Years.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.

Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests, hotel change, etc., before the beginning of the trip.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy | Explore the life of Sri Lankan Elephants in Pinnawala
days.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, the representative will take you to Kandy. En route, make a pit stop at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, providing a nurturing haven for rescued elephants. Continue to Kandy, and proceed towards the hotel. Check-in at the hotel and take a moment to relax. In the evening, relish the scenic views from Upper Lake Drive and be enchanted by the mesmerizing Kandyan Dance performance in town. After your exploration, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to Kandy via Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage.
In the evening, the representative will pick you up from the hotel in Kandy and take you to Upper Lake Drive.
Afterwards, get transferred to witness the Kandyan Dance performance
After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to the hotel in Kandy.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
items.desc:
Upon reaching Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, observe the elephants partaking in their bathing ritual in the adjacent river.
Explore the orphanage premises, witness feeding sessions, and gain insights into elephant conservation initiatives.
Take a leisurely walk amidst the verdant surroundings, creating lasting memories with these magnificent creatures.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Upper Lake Drive & Kandyan Dance Performance
items.desc:
Head to Upper Lake Drive, a scenic spot offering panoramic views of Kandy and the surrounding hills.
Take leisurely walks around the area, capturing the picturesque landscapes.
Afterwards, attend a Kandyan Dance Performance, showcasing traditional Sri Lankan dance forms, rituals, and drumming.
The vibrant cultural display provides insight into the island's rich heritage.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | To the City Of Lights
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Nuwara Eliya. Once you arrive, get transferred to the hotel and check in. After a while, get ready to explore the city. Start with the Gregory Lake where you can enjoy boating. Continue towards the historic Hanuman Temple, believed to be Hanuman's first landing site on the quest for Goddess Sita. Visit other attractions like Seetha Amman Temple & majestic Ramboda Falls. Afterwards, return to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Kandy and take you to the hotel in Nuwara Eliya.
After settling in, get picked up from the hotel in Nuwara Eliya for a sightseeing tour.
After the tour, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Start the tour by visiting Gregory Lake, a serene reservoir surrounded by lush landscapes where you can enjoy boating amidst the tranquil surroundings. (Additional cost)
Next, explore the Hanuman Temple, believed to be the first place where Hanuman landed in his quest for Goddess Sita. Absorb the spiritual ambience and enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings.
Continue towards Seetha Amman Temple, situated at the location where Seeta Mata, from the Hindu epic Ramayana, spent her days in Ravana's prison. Explore the temple's spiritual significance and the surrounding lush landscapes.
At the end, visit the magnificent Ramboda Falls, the eleventh-tallest waterfall in Sri Lanka. Marvel at the 109-meter-high cascade and capture breathtaking photos of the natural beauty that surrounds it.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Yala | Explore the Wildlife at Yala National Park
days.desc: After breakfast, check out and meet the representative who will take you to Yala. Once you arrive, get transferred to the hotel and proceed with the check-in formalities. After settling in, get transferred to Yala National Park for an adventurous safari through its diverse landscapes & encounter majestic wildlife, including elusive leopards, elephants, and vibrant bird species. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Nuwara Eliya and transfer you to Yala.
After settling in the hotel in Yala, get picked up for the Safari in Yala National Park.
After the Safari, get transferred back to the hotel in Yala.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Transfer in Jeep
items.desc: 1 X Jeep will be Provided

items.title: A Thrilling Safari at Yala National Park
items.desc:
Enter the park and embark on a thrilling adventure through diverse ecosystems, from dense jungles to open plains.
Keep a keen eye out for the park's diverse inhabitants, including the elusive leopard, majestic elephants, sloth bears, spotted deer, and a plethora of bird species.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

days.title: Yala to Bentota | To the city of Golden Beaches
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Bentota, the city of Golden Beaches. Once you arrive get transferred to the hotel and proceed with the check-in formalities. After a while, visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, the prime turtle nesting site. Afterwards, get transferred to Madhu River where you can enjoy a boat ride amidst the tranquil environment. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Yala and take you to the hotel in Bentota.
After settling in the hotel, get transferred for the sightseeing tour.
After exploration, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Yala and take you to the hotel in Bentota.
After settling in the hotel, get transferred for the sightseeing tour.
After exploration, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
items.desc:
Head towards Kosgoda to visit the Turtle Hatchery. Witness the remarkable process of nurturing newborn turtle hatchlings in large tanks.
Learn about the conservation efforts and see how these baby turtles are fed before being released into the sea after 2-4 days.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Leisurely Evening at Madu River
items.desc:
Indulge in a leisurely evening at the Madu River, an idyllic destination offering a tranquil escape.
You can hop on a boat and embark on a serene journey along the river, surrounded by lush mangroves and the soothing sounds of nature. 
As the sun sets, the riverbanks come alive with the warm hues of twilight, creating a picturesque backdrop for a peaceful and immersive experience.

days.title: Bentota - Colombo | Drive to Sri Lanka's Prime City
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to Colombo, the capital city of Sri Lanka. Once you arrive at the hotel in Colombo, check-in and relax for a while. Afterwards, get transferred to witness the historical, religious and commercial sites of Colombo including Fort & Pettah. Witness other attractions like Lotus Tower, Lover’s Island, and more. In the evening, you can stroll on the shopping streets. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel in Bentota and transfer you to the hotel in Colombo.
Once you get settled in, get picked up from the hotel in Colombo for the city exploration.
Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: 1 X Sedan will be Provided

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing
items.desc:
Start at the historic Fort area, walking through its colonial remnants, including the Old Parliament and Dutch Hospital.
Explore Pettah's bustling market, known for its vibrant streets, diverse shops, and the Red Mosque.
Head to the iconic Lotus Tower, Sri Lanka's tallest tower where you can also enjoy panoramic views of Colombo from its observation deck.
Visit the rooftop Sky Lounge for a relaxing break with cityscape views.
Head to Galle Face Green, a popular seaside promenade. Enjoy a stroll, witness the sunset, and engage in local street food delights.

days.title: Departure | Take a bag full of memories
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and meet the representative who will take you to the airport to board a flight back home. Take a bag full of memories to cherish for eternity.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to the airport to catch a flight back home.
